findings.issue: handleStall and the happy path share the escalated flag but checked SEPARATE fingerprint fields (stallFingerprint vs fingerprint). After an escalation, a stall<->happy mode transition got stuck in already-escalated because the other mode fingerprint was null, so resume never fired and the worker silently stuck (re-introducing a stall after escalation+resume).
findings.recommendation: Unify on shared fingerprint + noProgressStreak fields; keep only stallCount stall-specific.
findings.evidenceNote: code-traced the null-fingerprint resume path; wrote + executed regression test 'resumes across a stall->happy mode transition after escalation (F1)' — passes after fix
